visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses and a yellow and black plaid shirt sits at a light-colored wooden table, holding a black transparent 'ita-bag' with both hands. He looks at the bag with a focused, neutral expression. In the background, a woman in a black t-shirt and a light green surgical mask turns from her computer desk to look at him. The setting is an indoor workspace with white curtains and a brown leather sofa. (2) The man suddenly lifts the bag, which now prominently displays three shiny 'Yu-Gi-Oh!' trading cards inside. Large stylized yellow Japanese characters '神だ' appear as a graphic overlay over the center of the frame. The man's facial expression shifts to an intense, wide-eyed dramatic look with his mouth slightly open. (3) The scene cuts to a closer view of the bag held against his shoulder, showing the cards clearly. The man stands up and poses dramatically, revealing a golden pyramid necklace around his neck and a white and red toy duel disk attached to his left forearm. He is wearing blue jeans and a white t-shirt under his plaid shirt. (4) The man turns away and walks through an open dark brown doorway into a hallway. He holds the bag over his shoulder and poses with the duel disk arm extended forward. White subtitles with black outlines appear at the bottom of the screen. (5) The camera cuts back to the woman at her desk; she blinks and maintains a bewildered, confused expression while looking toward the doorway before turning back to her computer monitor which displays various web pages.
